blocks.info: Six Artifact types exist now, two of which overlap with this runtime. What each one is for.

blocks.text: Claude Docs covers the case this repo was built for in September: a document a person and Claude revise together. It is better at the parts this runtime is weak at, namely several people writing at once and comment threads. It does not carry the two things this runtime exists for: a typed journal that tells me what a gesture meant, and the Verbolia templates. That overlap is Q1, and it is a real question rather than a rhetorical one.

head: When you need
Reach for
Because
rows: a document you and I revise over rounds
your edits arrive as typed operations, so a round starts from what you meant, not from a diff
several people writing in one document at once
real-time co-editing and comment threads; this runtime has one writer and refuses a save that collides
a deck to present or send
16:9, downloads as pptx or pdf; a deck has no prose blocks a reader edits, so it is not a living document
declaring `db` makes an artefact organization-internal, with no exception
this runtime stores a figure and its words, never a query
`verbolia-prd` publishes a tabbed editable page of its own; it predates the fused form and overlaps the house template
